sources.title: Workflow providers
sources.locator: GitHub Actions and GitLab CI providers
sources.finding: Lists workflow runs, logs and actions for GitHub Actions and GitLab CI from the worktree sidebar.

sources.title: Review session store
sources.finding: Stores local review sessions and comments on diffs.

sources.title: aizen CLI
sources.finding: Swift CLI that opens projects, lists workspaces and attaches to tmux-backed terminals using the app's store.

sources.title: Analytics settings
sources.finding: Anonymous Umami analytics default on with a toggle in Settings, General.

sources.title: Analytics toggle
sources.finding: Settings toggle that disables usage analytics.

sources.title: App Info.plist
sources.finding: Sparkle update feed hosted by the vendor.

sources.title: Support Aizen button
sources.finding: The only use of license state in the sidebar toggles a Support Aizen button; no feature is gated on it in this release.

sources.title: Review comments as chat attachment
sources.finding: Review comments are attached to the agent chat input as Markdown.

sources.title: Voice input
sources.finding: On-device voice input and recording services.

sources.title: Chat persistence
sources.locator: Core Data session persistence and resume
sources.finding: Chat sessions persist in Core Data and resume.

sources.title: tmux cleanup
sources.finding: Optional tmux-backed terminal persistence with cleanup of orphaned sessions.

sources.title: Bounded search: users, roles, SSO and sharing
sources.finding: No accounts, roles, SSO or shared sessions; the only account concept is the Pro license.

sources.title: Bounded search: remote execution and mobile
sources.locator: grep -Eni remote worker|ssh server|vps|cloud runner|ios app|android over aizen/ and cli/; Requirements section
sources.finding: No remote execution, cloud runner, headless server or mobile client; Apple Silicon macOS only.

sources.title: Bounded search: native issue tracker
sources.finding: No native issue or task backlog; environments carry a status filter (ItemStatus) and notes only.

sources.title: Bounded search: living specifications
sources.locator: grep -Eni living spec|requirements|drift over docs/specs and aizen
sources.finding: docs/specs are internal engineering specs for Aizen itself, not a product feature.

sources.title: Bounded search: cost, usage and limits
sources.locator: grep -Eni token usage|cost|budget|limit|timeout over aizen/Features/Chat and Settings
sources.finding: No token, cost or budget display or limits in the chat; only ACP protocol state.

sources.title: Bounded search: schedules and triggers
sources.locator: grep -Eni schedule|cron|automation|webhook|trigger over aizen/Features and cli/
sources.finding: No scheduler, event triggers or webhooks.
